description.value: Your focus locks onto a target and fires a miniaturized ion warhead. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 ion damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one; on a failed save, it can't regain Force points, Tech points, or temporary hit points until the end of its next turn.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
